title: ViolationEvent
description: Violation event: ML worker → backend (POST /api/events). Coordinates are normalized to 0..1 of the frame size. The same object is described in openapi.yaml as EventIn — ml/tests/test_contracts.py checks that they match.

ts.description: Frame time, ISO 8601 with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-21T10:00:00Z

frame_id.description: Frame number in the camera stream

type.description: Type code from contracts/violation_types.json (code, name, severity)

bbox.description: Person box [x1, y1, x2, y2], normalized 0..1; x1 < x2, y1 < y2. For zone-level events (lone_worker, overcrowding) - the bounds of the zone polygon; such events have no track_id, but have a zone_id

track_id.description: Person track id: one violation by one person is one event, not an event per frame. Optional: without a track the backend groups the incident by camera and type

snapshot_url.description: Annotated frame snapshot: first POST /api/snapshots, then put the returned url here

zone_id.description: For danger_zone and smoking — zone id from GET /api/cameras/{id}/zones

severity.description: Severity; defaults to the registry value for the type

incident_id.description: Incident: a series of events of one violation by one track; set by the backend if the worker did not provide it

count.description: How many times the violation repeated within the incident
